title: Learning reminder schedule anchors
description: Phase 2B interim data (not yet a database contract): per-theme/rule/chapter source availability dates plus the chronologically next applicable chapter date, so Phase 2A/Worker can compute dueOn = sourceAvailableOn + RuleDefinition.DefaultDelayDays and pass nextAvailableOn into Notification.evaluate_learning_reminder_candidate to cap expiry. 'Next' is defined by date, not by classNumber+1 -- see dataQualityWarnings.

cohortCalendarLimitations.description: Themes with more than one concrete CourseCodeId where per-cohort calendar equivalence has not been verified. Do not enable a rule across every cohort of such a theme without checking this list.

dataQualityWarnings.description: Reported anomalies in the underlying course-progress-data.json (e.g. classNumber order disagreeing with availableDate order). These are surfaced, never silently corrected.

nextAvailableOn.description: Strictly greater than sourceAvailableOn when not null (mirrors evaluate_learning_reminder_candidate's invalid_expiry_boundary check).
